title: Page 317
transc:
Ft Monroe Jan. 6 / 65
S. H. Beckwith 
City Point Monroe
Imogene to John unity I arrived here an hour
ago enroute for garter peasant Hill ton heard and
shall remain until whelp morning zebra Have you any
word you wish to send or any military news
zodiac Belcher Town send and Barnes are with me
yoke Bruno -  Geo. D. Sheldon


Ft Monroe Jan. 6 / 65
J. W Sampson Baltimore
on board weasler tremble urn animal Jennie for
paradise Are M Newport Sheaf vinton baptism unity
If the Baltic hasbin ordered to Appian consider
the order as Counter man dead zebra Let
her quorum whiskey as before ordered youth Bender
Geo D. Sheldon


Ft Monroe Jan. 6 / 65
Maj Eckert Washington
Jennie Animal Hannah for Mrs Ellen H. Stand
ton growl arrived here safely will remain until
whelp morning and then start for Germany Brutus
Geo. D. Sheldon


City Point Jan'y 6 1865
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe 
please ascertain immed'y if Knox has
stomach animal & if so when
& when bound unity don't mention
that I enquired keep me posted
S. H. Beckwith
